decision.reason: [ev-ef5cca6f9d3b] only says that some storage options are deprecated, including the BoltDB store, and links to the storage docs page without naming any configuration key. So the proposed subject config-key path "storage" is not stated in the evidence, and the line may cover several options. The section context [ev-d76b5a54d0e6] and the upgrade-guide excerpts [ev-8b7267b73a1c] don't name the deprecated key either. To decide the subject, we need the linked storage docs, which list the deprecated options and the exact keys or values (for example, how the BoltDB index or store type is selected). The change type (deprecated) is supported, but the subject is not.
